name: Tir na mBan

attributes.attribute: a floating isle of the fairies

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tir na mBan is the land of women in Irish myth. It stands far off the coast as a floating isle. The fairy queens rule this land and take lovers from the world of men. Men who set foot there do not grow old.

okr.objective: Set down Tir na mBan as the land of women in Irish myth.
key_results: Gives the name land of women
Notes it as a floating isle
States men do not age there
